articles.title: 16-year-old charged with manufacturing firearm parts, threatening Pickering school
articles.summary: Police say a 16-year-old boy is facing charges after allegedly threatening to carry out a shooting at a Pickering, Ont., high school and making firearm parts with a 3D printer.

articles.title: Pedestrian dead after hit and run in Scarborough
articles.summary: A pedestrian is dead after a hit and run in Scarborough early Friday morning, police said. They said the driver fled the scene with no details on the vehicle at this time.

articles.title: The battle between Mississauga's current and ex mayor
articles.summary: Mississauga’s current and former mayors are at odds, and the political fallout is making waves. CBC's Chris Glover speaks with two guests to analyze the high-stakes dynamic between Carolyn Parrish and Bonnie Crombie. Tune in to hear what’s driving this rivalry and what it means for local voter turnout.

articles.title: Rogers becomes sole owner of MLSE after purchasing remaining 25% stake
articles.summary: Rogers Communications Inc. says it has completed its purchase of the remaining 25 per cent stake in Maple Leaf Sports & Entertainment from Larry Tanenbaum's Kilmer Sports Inc.

articles.title: What to see at Nuit Blanche Toronto 2026
articles.summary: Old and new favourites are among the top projects as the night’s main exhibition takes over downtown with an underground rave, marching band and more. The 12-hour event returns Saturday, Oct. 3, at sundown.

articles.title: Man arrested for alleged arson at Toronto MP's home faces charges in another fire
articles.summary: Police say a man previously charged in an alleged arson outside the Toronto home of Liberal MP Salma Zahid is now also facing charges in a fire that took place days earlier at a vacant home in Ajax, Ont.

articles.title: 4 arrested after $100K in unpaid Highway 407 tolls linked to fraud scheme: Peel police
articles.summary: Four people have been charged in an alleged fraud scheme that Peel Regional Police say has been linked to more than $100,000 in unpaid Highway 407 ETR tolls.
